parsed.explanation: In June 2024, NVIDIA executed a ten-for-one stock split, and all share amounts were retroactively adjusted to reflect this split. This caused the fiscal year 2024 diluted share count to increase by exactly 10x (from ~2.494B to ~24.94B) in subsequent filings.
parsed.evidence_quote: In June 2024, we executed a ten\-for\-one stock split of our common stock\. All share, equity award, and per share amounts and related shareholders' equity balances presented herein have been retroactively adjusted to reflect the Stock Split.
